login.title: Log in
login.description: Enter your credentials below to use your account

signup.title: Sign up
signup.description: Create an account below to get started

request.title: Forgot password
request.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link
request.success: If that email is registered, a reset link is on its way.

confirm.title: Reset password
confirm.description: Choose a new password for your account
confirm.success: Your password has been reset. You can now log in.
confirm.error: Could not reset password. The link may have expired.

pendingApproval.title: Account created
pendingApproval.description: Your account has been created successfully, but it doesn't have access yet. Please ask an existing admin to promote your role so you can log in.
